title: EFFORT BATCH 29 (R1 load shape + R3): a forced failure of the host's OWN save load (main-thread continuation of HostLoadSession) reaches StartFailed - the lobby is handed back, the client in the lobby was never served its save. H-PROTONHOST-1 remnant (R3, 2026-09-28): the next Start is a NEW GAME in the same lobby, and nothing the failed load restored (owners, bought buildings, cash, colours, loans, rival attention) carries into the new world
preconditions: Fixture save1 (host melaus, Client1). Build with EFFORT BATCH 29 deployed (startfail lever reaches the host load; clientInLobby readout). The client joins the lobby BEFORE the failed load. NOTHING is saved.
oracles_absent: a start is already in flight on this machine

steps.expect_result: ^OK the next start continuation \(new game or host load\) throws once

expect_log.regex: \[Server\] HostLoadSession error - lobby restored, Start can be pressed again: System.InvalidOperationException: DEV startfail lever: forced host-load failure

steps.note: FIRST press: the host's own load throws once on the main thread (R3: this used to be logged as 'Host load' only - lobby wedged)
a wrongly served save would have landed by now
THE R3 CHECK: the host's lobby is usable again
THE R1 CHECK (load shape): the client was not served before the host's own load
R3 PREMISE: the failed load restored the save's owners into the host ledger (StartFailed undoes none of it)

expect_log.regex: \[Server\] new world \(new game\): ownership ledger cleared \([1-9]\d* owned, \d+ bought, \d+ cash, -?\d+ loan\(s\), -?\d+ rival attention row\(s\)\) - nothing from an earlier load carries in\.
\[Server\] New game init \+ intro scene loaded

steps.note: R3 SECOND press = New Game in the same lobby: the failed load's owners / bought buildings / cash / colours / loans / rival attention are cleared at the world boundary
both machines create characters (charconfirm) and settle
R3 THE CHECK: nothing from the failed load in the new world
the client was served the new world and settled
